skills.name: Stampede
skills.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff3175|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff728|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

skills.name: Fire Keeper
skills.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1064|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

skills.name: Incinerate
skills.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff4511|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

skills.name: Earthshield Mantle
skills.description:
Envelop your body in molten spikes to increase your damage done to monsters by |cffffff100|r and gain Major Resolve, increasing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r for |cffffff20|r seconds.

Power drawn from the heart of a volcano forms a damage shield around you that absorbs up to |cffffff12933|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds, scaling off your Max Health.

skills.name: Razor Caltrops
skills.description:
Hurl a ball of caltrops that scatter over the target area, dealing |cffffff641|r Physical Damage every |cffffff1|r second to enemies inside, and reducing their Movement Speed by |cffffff50|r%.

Enemies who take damage from the caltrops have Major Breach applied to them, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r for |cffffff4.1|r seconds.

skills.name: Standard of Might
skills.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff7687|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.
